title: Get started with arpirisk
text: estimate_treatment_effect() returns, long format, absolute risk difference 4 years (ard), restricted mean survival time difference 4 years months (rmst), hazard ratio (hr), 95% confidence interval (conf_low, conf_high).

what: ARPI Treatment Effects by Baseline Risk in Metastatic Prostate Cancer
title: ARPI Treatment Effects by Baseline Risk in Metastatic Prostate Cancer
text: Risk-based treatment effects androgen receptor pathway inhibitors (ARPIs) metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer (mHSPC), individual participant data 4706 patients LATITUDE, ARCHES, TITAN, ARASENS. Baseline risk: 4-year risk -cause death placebo plus androgen deprivation therapy (ADT), Cox model stratified trial 9 predictors (restricted cubic splines 5 laboratory values) uniform shrinkage linear predictor. Treatment effects ARPI plus ADT versus placebo plus ADT, modeled within trial smooth functions baseline-risk linear predictor pooled multivariate random-effects meta-analysis: 4-year absolute risk difference (ARD), restricted mean survival time difference 4 years (ΔRMST), hazard ratio (HR), 95% confidence interval. research education; medical device. web calculator https://github.com/wfukuokaya/arpirisk-app.

trial data 0 to 19,000; values above 8,322 scored at the cap #> 6                                         Restricted cubic spline; trial data 57 to 186 #> 7                                        Restricted cubic spline; trial data 24 to 61.5 #> 8 Restricted cubic spline; trial data 26 to 7,680; values above 4,824 scored at the cap #> 9 Restricted cubic spline; trial data 67 to 4,124; values above 1,470 scored at the cap #>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           definition #> 1                          Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status at the time of the treatment decision: 0, fully active; 1, restricted in strenuous activity; 2, able to care for oneself but unable to work. Rate current function, including limits from bone pain. The model scores 1 and 2 together. The trials did not enroll patients with a status of 3 or 4. #> 2                                                                                                                             Gleason score from the diagnostic biopsy, or from the prostatectomy specimen if the cancer recurred after surgery. ISUP grade group 5 equals a score of 9 or 10, and grade groups 1 to 4 equal 8 or lower. The model scores 9 or 10 versus 8 or lower. #> 3                                                                                                                                                            Metastasis in the lung, liver, or another visceral organ on CT or MRI. Bone and lymph node metastases do not count, nor do lesions seen only on PSMA PET, because the trials staged patients with conventional imaging. #> 4                                                              Number of lesions on the bone scan. The trials staged patients with bone scan and CT or MRI, so do not count lesions seen only on PSMA PET, which usually shows more. The model scores 4 groups, 0 to 3, 4 to 6, 7 to 10, and 11 or more, so an exact count above 10 is not needed; enter 11 or more for a superscan. #> 5   Serum PSA in ng/mL, which equals µg/L. PSA falls quickly once androgen deprivation therapy starts, so the timing of this test matters more than for the others. Values above 8,322 ng/mL are scored as 8,322 ng/mL. Enter the most recent value at the time of the treatment decision; values from many months into androgen deprivation therapy fall outside the trial setting. #> 6                                            Blood hemoglobin, in the unit your laboratory reports. Avoid a value obtained within a few weeks after a red cell transfusion, which overstates the patient's usual level. Enter the most recent value at the time of the treatment decision; values from many months into androgen deprivation therapy fall outside the trial setting. #> 7                                                          Serum albumin, in the unit your laboratory reports. A value measured during an acute illness or hospital admission may understate the patient's usual level. Enter the most recent value at the time of the treatment decision; values from many months into androgen deprivation therapy fall outside the trial setting. #> 8 Total serum alkaline phosphatase in U/L, not bone-specific alkaline phosphatase and not a multiple of the upper limit of normal. Liver disease also raises the value. Values above 4,824 U/L are scored as 4,824 U/L. Enter the most recent value at the time of the treatment decision; values from many months into androgen deprivation therapy fall outside the trial setting. #> 9                                       Serum lactate dehydrogenase in U/L, not a multiple of the upper limit of normal. A hemolyzed sample gives a falsely high value. Values above 1,470 U/L are scored as 1,470 U/L. Enter the most recent value at the time of the treatment decision; values from many months into androgen deprivation therapy fall outside the trial setting.

title: arpirisk 0.1.0
text: Model version 261002-raw-rcs replaces 260803-raw-rcs. linear-predictor center matches baseline hazards, raises predicted risks; example patient tests moves 53% 62%. First version: baseline risk, treatment effects across baseline risk, input checks, plotting, Shiny calculator exportable Shinylive. Model version 260803-raw-rcs. synthetic-cohort check (data-raw/synthetic_cohort_check.R) runs analysis export code simulated trials; package reproduces rms predictions 1e-9. showed exported linear-predictor center must match survival::coxph(), uses 0 reference 0/1 factor columns. rms center, predicted risks low (34% versus 45% observed simulation). model specification built 260803 export problem; fixed 261002_script.R checked data-raw/remote_golden_cases.R. treatment_effect_curve() returns pooled effect curves custom figures tables. example_patients provides 6 synthetic patients spanning range baseline risk, model_inputs() gains definition column. Calculator: note every input obtaining value routine care (timing relative androgen deprivation therapy, conventional imaging versus PSMA PET, laboratory methods, upper caps), notes close click outside , hemoglobin mmol/L alkaline phosphatase lactate dehydrogenase microkatal per liter, risk death ARPI plus ADT shown beside baseline risk, inputs filled query string, model-specification panel coefficients. “Get started” vignette. Calculator design: brand file (_brand.yml) following Quarto’s default HTML look (system sans-serif fonts white page) JAMA color palette, applied generated CSS variables; title white layered radial gradient, chosen random page load. calculator treatment-effect plot describe comparator ADT alone, use practice without placebo; panel explains corresponds placebo plus ADT arms trials. treatment-effect plot shows baseline risk 0% 100%, curve covering range observed trials.
